supporting_observations.claim: On WS-DSHARMA-01, dev.sharma launched cmd.exe and then OpenSSH ssh.exe with the command `ssh.exe dev.sharma@PROXY-RB-01.riverbend.local`. The supplied environment context says no remote-access tools other than RDP or remote PowerShell are approved; these records show the SSH invocation, but not whether it connected or what occurred on the proxy.

FILE-RB-01 made Kerberos, LDAP, and SMB activity to DC-RB-01 under its computer account. The records identify LSASS or System as the originating process for this activity; they do not establish that it was part of the alerted RDP session.
A WmiPrvSE.exe process was created on FILE-RB-01 under SYSTEM at 13:28:26 UTC. These process records do not identify a remote initiator or tie the process to dev.sharma or the RDP alert.

At 13:53:33 UTC, the proxy recorded FILE-RB-01 connecting to www.bing.com with user unset and user agent Go-http-client/1.1. The record does not identify the originating process or establish a connection to the alerted RDP session.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include an event explicitly documenting the reported 13:42 UTC RDP logon, its source host, its logon ID, or the session's activity on FILE-RB-01.
The SSH process records show a command invocation but do not establish a successful connection or provide corresponding PROXY-RB-01 session logs (S21-00095, S21-00096).
The supplied records do not identify the process responsible for the FILE-RB-01 proxy connection to www.bing.com (S21-00300).
claims_not_established: Whether the reported RDP session occurred as described, and whether its source was the approved WS-DSHARMA-01.
Whether dev.sharma initiated or controlled the reported session, or whether the account was being misused.
Whether the SSH invocation succeeded or was authorized by a change or operational exception (S21-00095, S21-00096).
Whether the WmiPrvSE.exe process or the www.bing.com connection was related to the reported session or malicious activity (S21-00084, S21-00085, S21-00300).
additional_evidence_needed: FILE-RB-01 Security events for the relevant interval, especially successful logons (4624, including logon type and source address), logoff events, and Remote Desktop Services session logs.
The RDP alert's underlying source, destination, account, session or logon identifiers, and event timestamps.
WS-DSHARMA-01 and PROXY-RB-01 network and authentication logs to determine whether the SSH invocation connected and what account and commands were used.
FILE-RB-01 process and network telemetry around 13:42–14:20 UTC, including the process responsible for the www.bing.com connection.
Relevant change or incident tickets for the session, SSH use, and any activity on FILE-RB-01 during this interval.
